facts.fact: 叙述者立誓：把自己身体、灵魂与内脏献给十万筐魔鬼，以防在这部 History 中撒哪怕一个字谎。
facts.anchor: I offer myself, body and soul, tripe and bowels, to a hundred thousand basket-loads of fine devils in case I lie in so much as a single word in the whole of this History.

facts.fact: 若读者不坚信叙述者所讲的一切，愿圣安东尼之火、癫痫、雷击与腿溃疡、痢疾等灾祸折磨其身。
facts.anchor: may St. Anthony’s fire burn you, the epilepsy throw you, the thunder-stroke and leg-ulcers rack you, dysentery seize you

facts.fact: 引文出处标注为《庞大固埃》第 2 部作者序，1532 年。
facts.anchor: Author’s Prologue to the 2nd Book, Pantagruel, 1532

facts.fact: 序文作者署名为已故的 M. Alcofribas（「精髓提炼者」），即医学博士弗朗索瓦·拉伯雷。
facts.anchor: Composed by the late M. Alcofribas, Abstractor of the Quintessence, aka François Rabelais, Doctor of Medicine

facts.fact: 英文译文出自 J. M. Cohen 译本。
叙述者要求读者坚信「这部编年史」中的一切，否则将如所多玛与蛾摩拉般化为硫磺与火湖。
facts.anchor: everything that I tell you in this present Chronicle!
